origin: Hodgdon Reloading Manual 2024, shotshell data (12 gauge 2 3/4", 1 and 1 1/8 oz lead shot; loads, velocities, PSI pressures; tools/loaddata)
descr: FOR SHOTSHELLS ONLY (caliber with Shotshell = yes). The burn rate Ba is fitted to 192 published shotgun loads with the shotshell model of the solver (shot column and 2.5 g wad as the projectile, 28 inch barrel): velocity error 3.0 % rms, pressure error 14 % rms (pressure varies with wad and primer, which the model does not know). With a rifle or handgun cartridge the value is wrong: use another record of this powder. Not published and therefore only typical values: Qex, k, material and bulk density, form function. Check every load against the manufacturer's current load data.
